responsibility: Implements GCC’s GIMPLE tail-call optimization passes. It discovers return-path calls that are eligible for sibling-call optimization or self-recursive tail-recursion elimination, checks target- and function-level constraints such as alloca, setjmp, EH, and argument-address-taking, rewrites self recursion into loops with PHIs and optional additive/multiplicative accumulators for simple associative return patterns, annotates or preserves non-recursive tail calls for later RTL sibcall handling, and registers the tailr and tailc gimple_opt_pass instances that run these transformations on SSA CFGs.
